Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
import java.util.*;
class Main {
    
    public static int factorial(int n)
    {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        return n * factorial(n-1);
    }
    
    
    public static int removeVowelsAndGetLength(String s)
    {
        String ans = s.replaceAll("(?i)[a,e,i,o,u]", "");
        return ans.length();
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String arr[] = {"Madhu", "World"};
        int ans = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
        {
            int length = removeVowelsAndGetLength(arr[i]);
            ans = Math.max(ans, length);
        }
        System.out.println(factorial(ans));
    }
}
